messages:
ada: Heads-up: we're adding a new examples fixture and mandatory security header snippet in all public docs to reduce accidental key exposure and make examples runnable out-of-the-box. TL;DR: new fixture + small SDK helper.

frank: timeline?

ada: Plan: 2026-06-10 publish fixtures + migration guide; 2026-06-17 SDK patch adds `examples_fixture.json` loader and `X-Redwood-Example: true` header helper; 2026-07-01 docs CI enforces presence of the header in code blocks.

eng-sdk: SDK will include a no-secret fixture with placeholder tokens and a helper that strips secrets from pasted examples. Non-breaking. We'll emit a one-time info log when the helper runs.

sec-bot: Security note: header `X-Redwood-Example: true` flagged in logs as non-sensitive. This helps automated scanners ignore those requests in internal audits.

lina: do we also update interactive playground snippets? customers use those for quick testing.

ada: yes  playground will reference the same fixture and show a banner reminding users to swap placeholders with their own keys.

docs-bot: Draft fixture and guide uploaded: https://go.redwood/internal/examples-fixture-v1. Sample snippet required: ```json
{
  "headers": {"X-Redwood-Example": "true"},
  "auth": {"api_key": "REDACTED_EXAMPLE_KEY"}
}
```

frank: support impact?

ada: minimal. We'll publish a KB explaining the placeholder tokens and how to switch to production keys. Support will get the templated response.

eng-sdk: PR will include an opt-out env var `RW_EXAMPLES_FIXTURE=0` for internal testing.

sec-bot: Legal reviewed the approach, no contract changes.

ada: Owners: @eng-sdk (helper + PR), @docs-bot (fixture + guide + linter), @support (KB). Q&A drop-in 2026-06-08 10:00 PT. Ping here for blockers. :white_check_mark:
